Name: Cypher's Seasonal Premium Barns and Coops for SVE - (CP) and (AT)
Author: Genomecypher
Description:
I just wanted to make a simple visual retexture with copper roofs and a dinner bell (non-functioning) in the barn for the SVE premium buildings as my first attempt at a mod. The mod defaults to a green coop and red barn but has the option for a red coop if you want matching buildings. The copper metal roofs are default but I've also included a dark green shingle option. The buildings are seasonal. Buildings can be configured using GMCM. Thanks to SVE for creating the buildings.

NEW! - Buildings are now paintable at Robin's! I love (love!) the copper roofs and they were my primary inspiration to make these mods but I wanted to give options. Both copper and shingle roofs are paintable and still seasonal. I also fixed a couple visual issues. 

Note: If you want the building colors to match make sure to select the red siding for both buildings. Green coop will tint darker. Trim changes only the barn/coop animal doors and entrance doors.
